text: うむ　ほんきで　ぶつかって　いくのじゃぞ！

structure.jp: ぶつかって　いくのじゃぞ！
structure.en: go and throw yourself at it!

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb shows the action heading forward, away from the speaker. ぶつかって　いく = 'go in and clash head-on'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のじゃ is the old-man form of のだ. Said to someone about what they should do, it works as a firm order. ぞ after it adds force. いくのじゃ = 'you are to go'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here shows the way something is done. ほんきで = 'in earnest, with everything you have'.
